deep-blue-touch.scent_zh: 薄荷和松针的清凉，闻起来让人一下子振作。
deep-blue-touch.scent_en: Cool mint and pine needles that perk you right up.
deep-blue-touch.benefit_zh: 已经稀释好的舒缓复方滚珠，涂上去皮肤有清凉感，运动后、久坐后按摩肩颈腰背都很方便。
deep-blue-touch.benefit_en: Deep Blue ready-diluted in a roller. It leaves a cool feeling on the skin and makes a quick massage for neck, shoulders and back after exercise or long sitting.
deep-blue-touch.use_zh: 直接滚涂在需要放松的肌肉上，用手掌推开。敏感肌也可以用，但避开眼睛和破损皮肤。
deep-blue-touch.use_en: Roll straight onto tired muscles and spread with your palm. Gentle enough for sensitive skin; keep away from eyes and broken skin.
deep-blue-touch.grace_zh: 适合放在包里或办公室，随手就能用。
deep-blue-touch.grace_en: One to keep in your bag or desk drawer.

deep-blue-rub-lotion.scent_zh: 清凉薄荷带一点木质香。
deep-blue-rub-lotion.scent_en: Cool mint with a touch of wood.
deep-blue-rub-lotion.benefit_zh: 把舒缓复方做成乳霜，按摩时更顺滑，皮肤留下清凉舒爽的感觉，适合大面积按摩。
deep-blue-rub-lotion.benefit_en: Deep Blue in a cream base, so it glides for larger areas and leaves skin feeling cool and refreshed.
deep-blue-rub-lotion.use_zh: 取适量在腰背、腿部或肩颈按摩到吸收，运动后和睡前都适合。
deep-blue-rub-lotion.use_en: Massage into the back, legs or shoulders until absorbed, after exercise or before bed.
deep-blue-rub-lotion.grace_zh: 家里有长辈或爱运动的人，这一支很实用。
deep-blue-rub-lotion.grace_en: Handy in homes with older relatives or keen exercisers.

deep-blue.scent_zh: 冬青、樟脑和薄荷的清凉，强烈而通透。
deep-blue.scent_en: Wintergreen, camphor and mint: strong and clear.
deep-blue.benefit_zh: 舒缓复方是按摩用油里的经典，清凉的感觉让紧绷的肌肉和关节觉得轻松。
deep-blue.benefit_en: A classic massage blend whose cool sensation helps tight muscles and joints feel easier.
deep-blue.use_zh: 和基底油稀释后按摩在需要的部位，每次几滴就够，涂完洗手避免碰到眼睛。
deep-blue.use_en: Dilute with carrier oil and massage where needed; a few drops is enough. Wash your hands after and keep away from eyes.
deep-blue.grace_zh: Grace 常用它做肩颈、腰背的按摩底子，再按客人情况加别的油。
deep-blue.grace_en: Grace often builds neck and back massages on it, adding other oils to suit the person.

deep-blue-roll-on.benefit_zh: 舒缓复方的滚珠瓶版本，随身带着，哪里紧就涂哪里。
deep-blue-roll-on.benefit_en: The roll-on version of Deep Blue: carry it and use it wherever you feel tight.
deep-blue-roll-on.use_zh: 直接滚涂在肩颈、手腕、膝盖，用手掌轻推开。
deep-blue-roll-on.use_en: Roll onto shoulders, wrists or knees and spread with your palm.
deep-blue-roll-on.grace_zh: 适合经常打字、提重物或运动的人。
deep-blue-roll-on.grace_en: Good for people who type, lift or train a lot.

deep-blue-stick-nhp.benefit_zh: 加拿大登记的天然健康产品香膏，含薄荷醇、水杨酸甲酯和樟脑，用于暂时舒缓肌肉和关节的不适。
deep-blue-stick-nhp.benefit_en: A Health Canada-registered stick with menthol, methyl salicylate and camphor for temporary relief of muscle and joint discomfort.
deep-blue-stick-nhp.use_zh: 直接涂在需要的部位，按包装说明的次数使用，不要用在破损皮肤上。
deep-blue-stick-nhp.use_en: Apply directly where needed as often as the label says; not on broken skin.
deep-blue-stick-nhp.grace_zh: 固体香膏不会漏，出门旅行最方便。
deep-blue-stick-nhp.grace_en: A solid stick that can't leak, ideal for travel.

clove-bud-oil-nhp.scent_zh: 辛香温热，带一点皮革般的深沉。
clove-bud-oil-nhp.scent_en: Warm spice with a deep, leathery edge.
clove-bud-oil-nhp.benefit_zh: 丁香是很温热的油，按摩时让身体觉得暖。登记为天然健康产品的这一款，常用于芳香按摩中舒缓肌肉和关节。
clove-bud-oil-nhp.benefit_en: Clove is a very warming oil. This registered NHP version is used in aromatherapy massage to ease muscles and joints.
clove-bud-oil-nhp.use_zh: 一定要充分稀释，少量加入按摩油中使用，敏感肌先做测试。
clove-bud-oil-nhp.use_en: Always dilute well and add only a little to a massage oil; patch-test on sensitive skin.
clove-bud-oil-nhp.grace_zh: 丁香很强，Grace 通常只在配方里放一两滴。
clove-bud-oil-nhp.grace_en: Clove is strong; Grace usually uses just a drop or two in a blend.

cypress-oil-nhp.scent_zh: 干净清新的木香，像雨后的柏树林。
cypress-oil-nhp.scent_en: Clean, fresh wood, like a cypress grove after rain.
cypress-oil-nhp.benefit_zh: 丝柏让人觉得轻快、通透，常加入腿部、腰背的按摩油里。
cypress-oil-nhp.benefit_en: Cypress feels light and moving, and often goes into massage oils for legs and back.
cypress-oil-nhp.use_zh: 和基底油稀释后，从脚踝往上按摩腿部，或者按摩腰背。
cypress-oil-nhp.use_en: Dilute and massage the legs from ankle upward, or the back.
cypress-oil-nhp.grace_zh: 久站久坐、腿觉得沉的人，Grace 常推荐丝柏。
cypress-oil-nhp.grace_en: For heavy legs from standing or sitting, Grace often reaches for cypress.

clary-sage-oil.scent_zh: 草本带花香，尾韵有泥土的温暖。
clary-sage-oil.scent_en: Herbal and floral with a warm, earthy finish.
clary-sage-oil.benefit_zh: 快乐鼠尾草是女性最常用的精油之一，香气让人放松，经期前后用来按摩小腹特别舒服。
clary-sage-oil.benefit_en: One of the most-loved oils for women. Its scent is relaxing, and it feels especially good in a belly massage around your period.
clary-sage-oil.use_zh: 睡前滴几滴到香薰机，或者稀释后按摩小腹；泡澡时加几滴也很放松。备孕和孕期请不要使用。
clary-sage-oil.use_en: Diffuse a few drops before bed, or dilute and massage the belly; a few drops in the bath relax you too. Avoid when trying to conceive or pregnant.
clary-sage-oil.grace_zh: Grace 帮女性客人调周期配方时，几乎都会用到它。
clary-sage-oil.grace_en: Grace uses it in almost every cycle blend she makes for women.

juniper-berry-oil-nhp.scent_zh: 干净的木质香，带一点浆果和香料。
juniper-berry-oil-nhp.scent_en: Clean wood with berry and spice.
juniper-berry-oil-nhp.benefit_zh: 杜松浆果清爽净化，香气让人沉静，常用在下腹、腰背的按摩里。
juniper-berry-oil-nhp.benefit_en: Juniper berry is fresh and clarifying with a calming scent, often used in belly and back massage.
juniper-berry-oil-nhp.use_zh: 稀释后按摩小腹和后腰，或者扩香让空间清爽。
juniper-berry-oil-nhp.use_en: Dilute and massage the lower belly and back, or diffuse to freshen a room.
juniper-berry-oil-nhp.grace_zh: 想要清爽又安静的香气，可以试试它。
juniper-berry-oil-nhp.grace_en: Try it when you want something both fresh and quiet.

lemongrass-oil-nhp.scent_zh: 柑橘般的青草香，带一点烟熏。
lemongrass-oil-nhp.scent_en: Citrusy grass with a hint of smoke.
lemongrass-oil-nhp.benefit_zh: 柠檬草清新提神，按摩时让人放松又振作，常加入肩颈、关节的配方。
lemongrass-oil-nhp.benefit_en: Lemongrass is fresh and uplifting, relaxing yet energising in massage, often in neck and joint blends.
lemongrass-oil-nhp.use_zh: 一定要稀释，加入按摩油按摩肩颈或关节；扩香可以让空间清新。
lemongrass-oil-nhp.use_en: Always dilute; add to a massage oil for neck or joints, or diffuse to freshen the air.
lemongrass-oil-nhp.grace_zh: 柠檬草对皮肤比较强，Grace 通常用少量。
lemongrass-oil-nhp.grace_en: It can be strong on skin, so Grace uses it sparingly.

helichrysum-oil-nhp.scent_zh: 蜜香、干草和草本，温暖柔和。
helichrysum-oil-nhp.scent_en: Honey, hay and herbs: warm and soft.
helichrysum-oil-nhp.benefit_zh: 永久花是很珍贵的花朵精油，温和照顾肌肤，也常加入舒缓肌肉的按摩油里。
helichrysum-oil-nhp.benefit_en: A precious flower oil that gently cares for skin and often goes into soothing massage oils.
helichrysum-oil-nhp.use_zh: 稀释后涂抹需要照顾的肌肤，或者加入按摩油；护肤时每次一两滴就够。
helichrysum-oil-nhp.use_en: Dilute and apply to skin that needs care, or add to a massage oil; one or two drops is enough for skin care.
helichrysum-oil-nhp.grace_zh: Grace 的护肤和眼周配方里，永久花常常是主角。
helichrysum-oil-nhp.grace_en: Helichrysum is often the lead in Grace's skin and eye-area blends.

petitgrain-oil-nhp.scent_zh: 橙树叶的清爽花香，淡淡的草本。
petitgrain-oil-nhp.scent_en: Fresh orange-leaf florals with soft herbs.
petitgrain-oil-nhp.benefit_zh: 苦橙叶香气清淡、让人放松，常用来舒缓紧张，也加入肩颈和关节的按摩。
petitgrain-oil-nhp.benefit_en: Petitgrain has a light, relaxing scent that eases tension and also goes into neck and joint massage.
petitgrain-oil-nhp.use_zh: 睡前扩香，或者稀释后按摩肩颈。
petitgrain-oil-nhp.use_en: Diffuse at bedtime, or dilute and massage the neck and shoulders.
petitgrain-oil-nhp.grace_zh: 不喜欢浓郁花香的人，苦橙叶是很好的放松选择。
petitgrain-oil-nhp.grace_en: A good relaxing choice for people who don't like heavy florals.

lime-oil-nhp.benefit_zh: 莱姆的香气让人心情轻快，适合扩香提神，也可以加入按摩油。
lime-oil-nhp.benefit_en: Lime lifts the mood; diffuse it for a fresh start or add it to a massage oil.
lime-oil-nhp.use_zh: 扩香或者涂在手心嗅吸。柑橘类涂抹后 12 小时内避免日晒。
lime-oil-nhp.use_en: Diffuse or breathe from your palms. Avoid sun on the skin for 12 hours after applying citrus oils.
lime-oil-nhp.grace_zh: Grace 常用它给配方加一点亮度。
lime-oil-nhp.grace_en: Grace often uses it to add brightness to a blend.

peppermint-essential-oil.benefit_zh: 椒样薄荷的清凉感让人一下子清醒，也让按摩时的肌肉觉得舒爽，是家里最常用的精油之一。
peppermint-essential-oil.benefit_en: Peppermint's coolness wakes you up and makes muscles feel refreshed in massage; one of the most-used oils at home.
peppermint-essential-oil.use_zh: 开车、开会前滴一滴在手心嗅吸；稀释后按摩太阳穴或肩颈。避开眼睛，幼儿脸部不要用。
peppermint-essential-oil.use_en: Breathe a drop from your palms before driving or meetings; dilute and massage temples or neck. Keep away from eyes and young children's faces.
peppermint-essential-oil.grace_zh: 薄荷很强，Grace 会按每个人的接受度调整用量。
peppermint-essential-oil.grace_en: Peppermint is strong; Grace adjusts the amount to each person.

lavender-oil-nhp.scent_zh: 干净柔和的花香，带一点粉感。
lavender-oil-nhp.scent_en: Soft, clean florals with a powdery touch.
lavender-oil-nhp.benefit_zh: 薰衣草是最温和、最百搭的精油，让人放松、好入睡，也常用于舒缓肌肉和肌肤。
lavender-oil-nhp.benefit_en: The gentlest, most versatile oil: relaxing, sleep-friendly and soothing for muscles and skin.
lavender-oil-nhp.use_zh: 睡前扩香或滴在枕头上；稀释后按摩肩颈或涂抹需要照顾的肌肤。
lavender-oil-nhp.use_en: Diffuse or put a drop on your pillow at bedtime; dilute for neck massage or skin care.
lavender-oil-nhp.grace_zh: 第一次用精油，Grace 通常从薰衣草开始推荐。
lavender-oil-nhp.grace_en: For first-timers, Grace usually starts with lavender.

easy-air-touch.scent_zh: 清凉的薄荷和尤加利，像深呼吸一口山上的空气。
easy-air-touch.scent_en: Cool mint and eucalyptus, like a deep breath of mountain air.
easy-air-touch.benefit_zh: 稀释好的 Easy Air 滚珠，涂在胸口和后背让呼吸觉得清爽舒畅。
easy-air-touch.benefit_en: Easy Air ready-diluted in a roller; on the chest and back it makes breathing feel clear and easy.
easy-air-touch.use_zh: 滚涂在前胸、后背或喉咙外侧，睡前用也很舒服。
easy-air-touch.use_en: Roll onto chest, back or the outside of the throat; lovely at bedtime.
easy-air-touch.grace_zh: 换季的时候，Grace 会建议放一支在床头。
easy-air-touch.grace_en: When seasons change, Grace suggests keeping one by the bed.

hope-touch.scent_zh: 明亮清新的甜香，带花香和香草。
hope-touch.scent_en: Bright, fresh sweetness with florals and vanilla.
hope-touch.benefit_zh: 希望复方滚珠香气温柔正向，适合当作随身香氛；它的收入支持疗愈之手基金会帮助各地的人。
hope-touch.benefit_en: A warm, hopeful scent to wear; proceeds support the Healing Hands Foundation's work around the world.
hope-touch.use_zh: 滚涂在手腕、耳后或颈侧当香水用。
hope-touch.use_en: Roll onto wrists, behind the ears or the neck like a perfume.
hope-touch.grace_zh: 送人很合适，也是一份心意。
hope-touch.grace_en: A thoughtful gift with meaning behind it.

touch-supermint.scent_en: A sweet mix of several mints.
touch-supermint.benefit_zh: 清醇薄荷滚珠比单方薄荷柔和，提神又不刺激，按摩时皮肤清凉。
touch-supermint.benefit_en: Softer than plain peppermint: refreshing without the sting, cooling on the skin.
touch-supermint.use_zh: 滚涂在后颈、太阳穴或手腕，需要清醒时用。
touch-supermint.use_en: Roll onto the back of the neck, temples or wrists when you need to wake up.
touch-supermint.grace_zh: 怕薄荷太冲的人可以先试这一支。
touch-supermint.grace_en: Try this one if plain peppermint feels too strong.

rescuer.benefit_zh: 复援宝贝是给孩子设计的温和复方，跑跳玩耍后按摩腿脚很合适。
rescuer.benefit_en: A gentle blend made for children, good for massaging legs after running and playing.
rescuer.use_zh: 滚涂在孩子的腿部、脚底，轻轻按摩。
rescuer.use_en: Roll onto your child's legs and soles and massage gently.
rescuer.grace_zh: 孩子用的油，Grace 都会先确认年龄和用量。
rescuer.grace_en: For children's oils, Grace always checks age and amount first.

tamer-oil.scent_en: Sweet and minty, soft and comforting.
tamer-oil.benefit_zh: 悠活宝贝是给孩子的腹部按摩复方，香气温和，敏感肌也适用。
tamer-oil.benefit_en: A tummy-massage blend for children with a gentle scent, suitable for sensitive skin.
tamer-oil.use_zh: 滚涂在孩子的肚子上，顺时针轻揉。
tamer-oil.use_en: Roll onto your child's tummy and rub clockwise.
tamer-oil.grace_zh: 孩子饭后觉得胀的时候可以用。
tamer-oil.grace_en: Useful when a child feels full after meals.

supermint-oil-blend.benefit_zh: 清醇薄荷复方集合几种薄荷，扩香时让空间清新有活力，按摩时皮肤清凉。
supermint-oil-blend.benefit_en: Several mints together: diffuse for a lively, fresh room or massage for a cool feel.
supermint-oil-blend.use_zh: 扩香 3–4 滴，或稀释后按摩后颈。
supermint-oil-blend.use_en: Diffuse 3–4 drops, or dilute and massage the back of the neck.
supermint-oil-blend.grace_zh: 工作室下午常常扩这一款，大家精神都会好一点。
supermint-oil-blend.grace_en: A favourite in the studio on sleepy afternoons.

clarycalm-essential-oil.scent_en: Florals and herbs with a hint of conifer.
clarycalm-essential-oil.benefit_zh: 温柔呵护复方是给女性设计的滚珠，经期前后涂抹，让人觉得平衡、镇定。
clarycalm-essential-oil.benefit_en: A roller made for women; around your period it helps you feel balanced and calm.
clarycalm-essential-oil.use_zh: 滚涂在小腹和手腕，一天几次。孕期请先咨询。
clarycalm-essential-oil.use_en: Roll onto the belly and wrists a few times a day. Ask before using in pregnancy.
clarycalm-essential-oil.grace_zh: 想简单一点照顾周期，这一支最方便。
clarycalm-essential-oil.grace_en: The easiest way to care for your cycle.

pasttense.benefit_zh: 舒压复方专门给紧绷的头部和肩颈，涂上去清凉舒缓。
pasttense.benefit_en: Made for tense heads and shoulders; cool and soothing when applied.
pasttense.use_zh: 滚涂在太阳穴、后颈和肩膀，避开眼睛。
pasttense.use_en: Roll onto temples, back of the neck and shoulders, away from the eyes.
pasttense.grace_zh: Grace 自己的包里一直有一支。
pasttense.grace_en: Grace always has one in her own bag.

aromatouch.benefit_zh: 芳香调理复方是专业芳香按摩的核心油之一，让人宁静、放松。
aromatouch.benefit_en: A core oil in professional aroma massage, calming and relaxing.
aromatouch.use_zh: 稀释后用于全身按摩，或者滚涂在背部和脚底。
aromatouch.use_en: Dilute for full-body massage, or roll onto the back and soles.
aromatouch.grace_zh: Grace 的芳香调理疗程就是用这一系列油完成的。
aromatouch.grace_en: Grace's AromaTouch sessions are built around this oil.

touch-vetiver.scent_zh: 甜美的根部香，带焦糖和烟熏。
touch-vetiver.scent_en: Sweet root with caramel and smoke.
touch-vetiver.benefit_zh: 岩兰草滚珠香气朴实沉稳，让人安定下来，同时滋润肌肤。
touch-vetiver.benefit_en: An earthy, grounding vetiver roller that settles you and moisturises skin.
touch-vetiver.use_zh: 睡前滚涂在脚底和后颈，或在需要专注时涂手腕。
touch-vetiver.use_en: Roll onto soles and back of the neck at bedtime, or on wrists when you need to focus.
touch-vetiver.grace_zh: 心总是静不下来的人，可以试试岩兰草。
touch-vetiver.grace_en: Try vetiver if your mind won't settle.

clove-bud-oil.scent_en: Warm spice with a hint of leather.
clove-bud-oil.benefit_zh: 丁香香气温暖，也常用于口腔清新和料理，稀释后涂抹让皮肤觉得暖。
clove-bud-oil.benefit_en: Warm and spicy, used for fresh breath and in cooking; diluted on skin it feels warming.
clove-bud-oil.use_zh: 一滴加入温水漱口，或者少量稀释加进按摩油。
clove-bud-oil.use_en: One drop in warm water as a rinse, or a little diluted in a massage oil.
clove-bud-oil.grace_zh: 丁香很强，一两滴就足够。
clove-bud-oil.grace_en: Clove is strong; one or two drops is plenty.

cypress-oil.scent_zh: 洁净清新的木香和草本。
cypress-oil.benefit_zh: 丝柏让人觉得清爽、有活力，也能帮助皮肤保持水润平衡。
cypress-oil.benefit_en: Cypress feels fresh and energising and helps skin stay balanced and hydrated.
cypress-oil.use_zh: 稀释后按摩腿部、腰背，或扩香让空间清新。
cypress-oil.use_en: Dilute for leg or back massage, or diffuse for fresh air.
cypress-oil.grace_zh: Grace 的腿部和眼周配方里经常有丝柏。
cypress-oil.grace_en: Cypress appears often in Grace's leg and eye blends.

wintergreen-oil.scent_zh: 香甜的薄荷，清新有活力。
wintergreen-oil.benefit_zh: 冬青的清凉感很明显，按摩肌肉和关节时让人觉得放松。
wintergreen-oil.benefit_en: Wintergreen's coolness is strong and makes muscle and joint massage feel relaxing.
wintergreen-oil.use_zh: 必须稀释，少量加入按摩油。对阿司匹林过敏或正在服用抗凝药物的人请勿使用。
wintergreen-oil.use_en: Always dilute and use only a little. Not for people allergic to aspirin or on blood thinners.
wintergreen-oil.grace_zh: Grace 会先问清楚健康状况，再决定能不能用冬青。
wintergreen-oil.grace_en: Grace checks your health first before using wintergreen.

fractionated-coconut-oil.benefit_zh: 分馏椰子油是最常用的基底油，稀释精油、减少皮肤敏感，同时让皮肤柔软光滑。
fractionated-coconut-oil.benefit_en: The most-used carrier oil: it dilutes essential oils, reduces sensitivity and leaves skin soft.
fractionated-coconut-oil.use_zh: 调配滚珠瓶、按摩油时用它把精油稀释到合适浓度。
fractionated-coconut-oil.use_en: Use it to dilute oils to the right strength in rollers and massage oils.
fractionated-coconut-oil.grace_zh: Grace 调配的大部分配方都用它做基底。
fractionated-coconut-oil.grace_en: Most of Grace's blends use it as the base.

copaiba-essential-oil.benefit_zh: 古巴香脂取自树脂，让皮肤看起来更好、滋润干燥肌肤，香气让人平静踏实。
copaiba-essential-oil.benefit_en: From tree resin, it improves the look of skin, soothes dryness and has a calm, grounded scent.
copaiba-essential-oil.use_zh: 稀释后涂抹需要滋润的肌肤，或加入按摩油；扩香让空间安静。
copaiba-essential-oil.use_en: Dilute for dry skin or add to a massage oil; diffuse for a calm room.
copaiba-essential-oil.grace_zh: Grace 很喜欢用它让配方更温和。
copaiba-essential-oil.grace_en: Grace loves it for making blends gentler.

frankincense-touch.benefit_zh: 稀释好的乳香滚珠，滋润干燥肌肤、让肤色看起来健康，也照顾指甲和角质层。
frankincense-touch.benefit_en: Frankincense ready-diluted: it soothes dry skin, supports a healthy-looking complexion and cares for nails and cuticles.
frankincense-touch.use_zh: 睡前滚涂在脸颊、颈部或指甲周围，也可以涂手腕静心。
frankincense-touch.use_en: Roll onto cheeks, neck or cuticles at night, or on wrists to settle your mind.
frankincense-touch.grace_zh: 想每天都用乳香但不想自己调，这一支最省事。
frankincense-touch.grace_en: The easy way to use frankincense every day.

touch-copaiba.benefit_zh: 古巴香脂滚珠让肌肤光滑净透、保湿有光泽。
touch-copaiba.benefit_en: A copaiba roller for smooth, clear, well-moisturised, glowing skin.
touch-copaiba.use_zh: 洁面后滚涂在脸上或需要的地方，轻轻按开。
touch-copaiba.use_en: After cleansing, roll onto your face or where needed and press in.
touch-copaiba.grace_zh: 适合放在梳妆台上每天用。

touch-peppermint.benefit_zh: 稀释好的薄荷滚珠，清凉提神，敏感肌也可以放心用。
touch-peppermint.benefit_en: Ready-diluted peppermint: cool and refreshing, fine for sensitive skin.
touch-peppermint.use_zh: 滚涂在后颈、太阳穴或手腕，避开眼睛。
touch-peppermint.use_en: Roll onto the back of the neck, temples or wrists, away from the eyes.
touch-peppermint.grace_zh: 开长途车或下午犯困时很有用。
touch-peppermint.grace_en: Great on long drives or sleepy afternoons.

turmeric-oil.scent_zh: 温热辛香，带泥土和木香。
turmeric-oil.scent_en: Warm spice with earth and wood.
turmeric-oil.benefit_zh: 姜黄的香气温暖朴实，可以加入料理增添风味，也让皮肤看起来干净健康。
turmeric-oil.benefit_en: Turmeric's warm, earthy scent; add to cooking or use for clean, healthy-looking skin.
turmeric-oil.use_zh: 稀释后加入按摩油，或在料理中加一滴。
turmeric-oil.use_en: Dilute into a massage oil, or add a drop to cooking.
turmeric-oil.grace_zh: Grace 常把它放进温暖类的胸背配方。
turmeric-oil.grace_en: Grace adds it to warming chest-and-back blends.

eucalyptus-oil.scent_zh: 清凉通透的叶片香，带樟脑感。
eucalyptus-oil.benefit_zh: 尤加利让呼吸觉得通畅，香气提振，也能清洁皮肤和头皮。
eucalyptus-oil.benefit_en: Eucalyptus makes breathing feel open, lifts the mood and cleanses skin and scalp.
eucalyptus-oil.use_zh: 扩香或涂在手心嗅吸；稀释后涂胸口和后背。儿童请高度稀释。
eucalyptus-oil.use_en: Diffuse or breathe from your palms; dilute for chest and back. Dilute well for children.
eucalyptus-oil.grace_zh: 换季、开冷气、空气闷的时候，Grace 首选尤加利。
eucalyptus-oil.grace_en: Grace's first pick for seasonal change, air con and stuffy rooms.

juniper-berry-oil.benefit_zh: 杜松浆果让肤色看起来均匀明亮，香气镇定朴实，也能清新空气。
juniper-berry-oil.benefit_en: Juniper berry evens and brightens the look of skin, has a calm earthy scent and freshens air.
juniper-berry-oil.use_zh: 稀释后加入护肤油或按摩油，或扩香。
juniper-berry-oil.use_en: Dilute into skin or massage oil, or diffuse.
juniper-berry-oil.grace_zh: 想要清爽的木香，杜松浆果很合适。
juniper-berry-oil.grace_en: A good choice for a fresh woody scent.

lemongrass-oil.benefit_zh: 柠檬草稀释后让皮肤清爽，按摩时香气放松又振作，也能为料理增添香草风味。
lemongrass-oil.benefit_en: Diluted lemongrass leaves skin fresh, its massage scent relaxes yet lifts, and it flavours cooking.
lemongrass-oil.use_zh: 稀释后按摩，或扩香清新空气；对皮肤较强，要充分稀释。
lemongrass-oil.use_en: Dilute for massage or diffuse to freshen air; it's strong, so dilute well.
lemongrass-oil.grace_zh: Grace 常在关节和颈部配方里放一点。
lemongrass-oil.grace_en: Grace adds a little to joint and neck blends.

cassia-oil.benefit_zh: 桂皮香气温暖舒畅，稀释后让皮肤觉得暖，也常用在烘焙和清洁里。
cassia-oil.benefit_en: Cassia is warm and cheering; diluted it warms the skin, and it's used in baking and cleaning.
cassia-oil.use_zh: 必须充分稀释后才能涂抹，扩香时一两滴就够。
cassia-oil.use_en: Always dilute well before skin use; one or two drops is enough in a diffuser.
cassia-oil.grace_zh: 桂皮很强，Grace 只在需要暖意的配方里少量用。
cassia-oil.grace_en: Strong stuff; Grace uses only a little where warmth is needed.

birch-oil.benefit_zh: 桦木的清凉感让按摩更舒缓，香气爽利。
birch-oil.benefit_en: Birch's cool feel makes massage more soothing, with a crisp scent.
birch-oil.use_zh: 必须稀释，少量加入按摩油。对阿司匹林过敏或服用抗凝药物者请勿使用。
birch-oil.use_en: Always dilute and use sparingly. Not for people allergic to aspirin or on blood thinners.
birch-oil.grace_zh: Grace 会先了解健康状况再使用。

ginger-essential-oil.benefit_zh: 生姜的暖意很直接，按摩时舒缓温暖，怕冷的人特别喜欢。
ginger-essential-oil.benefit_en: Ginger's warmth is direct; it soothes and warms in massage, a favourite for people who feel the cold.
ginger-essential-oil.use_zh: 稀释后按摩腹部、腰背或脚底；一滴在手心嗅吸也很舒服。
ginger-essential-oil.use_en: Dilute for belly, back or foot massage; one drop breathed from your palms is lovely too.
ginger-essential-oil.grace_zh: Grace 的暖身和腹部配方里，生姜几乎是必备。
ginger-essential-oil.grace_en: Ginger is almost always in Grace's warming and belly blends.

thyme-oil.scent_en: Fresh herbs with a spicy edge.
thyme-oil.benefit_zh: 百里香清洁感强，按摩时香气振奋，也能清新口气和用于料理。
thyme-oil.benefit_en: Thyme feels strongly cleansing, lifts the mood in massage and freshens breath and food.
thyme-oil.use_zh: 必须充分稀释后涂抹，少量用于按摩或清洁。
thyme-oil.use_en: Dilute well before skin use; a little for massage or cleaning.
thyme-oil.grace_zh: Grace 在换季和头皮配方里会少量使用。
thyme-oil.grace_en: Grace uses a little in seasonal and scalp blends.

pink-pepper-oil.scent_en: Spicy and fruity with soft wood.
pink-pepper-oil.benefit_zh: 粉红胡椒让空间有活力，按摩时舒缓，也能增添料理风味。
pink-pepper-oil.benefit_en: Pink pepper livens up a room, soothes in massage and adds flavour to food.
pink-pepper-oil.use_zh: 扩香或稀释后加入按摩油。
pink-pepper-oil.use_en: Diffuse or dilute into a massage oil.
pink-pepper-oil.grace_zh: 想要一点不一样的暖香，可以试试它。
pink-pepper-oil.grace_en: Try it for a different kind of warmth.

spearmint-oil.benefit_zh: 绿薄荷比椒样薄荷温和香甜，提神又不刺激，适合孩子和怕冲的人。
spearmint-oil.benefit_en: Gentler and sweeter than peppermint: refreshing without the bite, good for children and the sensitive.
spearmint-oil.use_zh: 扩香或加入饮料，也可以稀释后按摩。
spearmint-oil.use_en: Diffuse, add to drinks or dilute for massage.
spearmint-oil.grace_zh: Grace 常用它让清凉配方变得柔和。
spearmint-oil.grace_en: Grace uses it to soften cooling blends.

basil-oil.benefit_zh: 罗勒的香气温暖，让肌肤觉得舒缓，也适合加入料理。
basil-oil.benefit_en: Basil's warm herbal scent soothes the skin and suits cooking too.
basil-oil.use_zh: 稀释后按摩腹部、腰背，或在料理中加一滴。
basil-oil.use_en: Dilute for belly or back massage, or add a drop to cooking.
basil-oil.grace_zh: Grace 的腰腹按摩配方常有罗勒。
basil-oil.grace_en: Basil often features in Grace's core massage blends.

cinnamon-bark-oil.scent_zh: 辛辣温甜的木香，香气绕梁。
cinnamon-bark-oil.benefit_zh: 肉桂香气温暖舒适，稀释后让皮肤觉得暖，也能清新口气。
cinnamon-bark-oil.benefit_en: Cinnamon is warm and comforting; diluted it warms the skin and freshens breath.
cinnamon-bark-oil.use_zh: 必须充分稀释，配方里通常只放一滴。
cinnamon-bark-oil.use_en: Always dilute well; usually just one drop in a blend.
cinnamon-bark-oil.grace_zh: 肉桂很强，Grace 只用一点点带出暖意。
cinnamon-bark-oil.grace_en: Very strong; Grace uses a touch for warmth.

coriander-oil.benefit_zh: 胡荽籽香气温和带甜，让肌肤舒缓，是腹部按摩很常用的油。
coriander-oil.benefit_en: Coriander seed is mild and sweet, soothing on skin and a staple in belly massage.
coriander-oil.use_zh: 稀释后顺时针按摩腹部，或加入料理。
coriander-oil.use_en: Dilute and massage the belly clockwise, or add to cooking.
coriander-oil.grace_zh: Grace 很多肠胃配方都会用到它。
coriander-oil.grace_en: Many of Grace's digestive blends use it.

jasmine-oil.scent_zh: 香甜温暖的花香，带异域风情。
jasmine-oil.benefit_zh: 茉莉香气让人愉悦、有自信，也能让肌肤看起来健康。
jasmine-oil.benefit_en: Jasmine lifts and inspires, and supports healthy-looking skin.
jasmine-oil.use_zh: 一滴涂在手腕或颈侧当香水，或加入护肤油。
jasmine-oil.use_en: A drop on wrists or neck as perfume, or added to skin oil.
jasmine-oil.grace_zh: 茉莉很珍贵，Grace 常在情绪和护肤配方里点缀一点。
jasmine-oil.grace_en: Precious oil; Grace adds a touch to mood and skin blends.

blue-tansy-oil.benefit_zh: 蓝艾菊让皮肤觉得清凉，按摩时香气镇定放松，也滋润干燥肌肤。
blue-tansy-oil.benefit_en: Blue tansy cools the skin, calms in massage and soothes dryness.
blue-tansy-oil.use_zh: 稀释后用于按摩或护肤；颜色是深蓝色，小心沾到衣服。
blue-tansy-oil.use_en: Dilute for massage or skin care; it's deep blue, so mind your clothes.
blue-tansy-oil.grace_zh: Grace 会用它让放松配方更有层次。
blue-tansy-oil.grace_en: Grace uses it to add depth to relaxing blends.

siberian-fir-oil.benefit_zh: 西伯利亚冷杉的森林香让空间宁静正向，按摩时舒缓放松。
siberian-fir-oil.benefit_en: Siberian fir brings a calm, positive forest feeling and relaxes in massage.
siberian-fir-oil.use_zh: 扩香，或稀释后按摩腿部和背部。
siberian-fir-oil.use_en: Diffuse, or dilute for leg and back massage.
siberian-fir-oil.grace_zh: 孩子和长辈都很喜欢这个味道。
siberian-fir-oil.grace_en: Children and elders both love this scent.

spanish-sage-oil.benefit_zh: 西班牙鼠尾草香气振奋舒缓，扩香时营造正向的氛围。
spanish-sage-oil.benefit_en: Spanish sage is uplifting and soothing, creating a positive mood when diffused.
spanish-sage-oil.use_zh: 扩香或稀释后涂胸背。孕期请避免。
spanish-sage-oil.use_en: Diffuse, or dilute for chest and back. Avoid in pregnancy.
spanish-sage-oil.grace_zh: Grace 会在呼吸类配方里搭配使用。
spanish-sage-oil.grace_en: Grace pairs it in breathing blends.

cardamom-oil.benefit_zh: 豆蔻香气温暖和谐，让人镇定，按摩时舒缓，也能加入饮品料理。
cardamom-oil.benefit_en: Cardamom is warm and harmonious, calming in massage and lovely in drinks.
cardamom-oil.use_zh: 一滴加入奶茶或咖啡，或稀释后按摩胸口和腹部。
cardamom-oil.use_en: A drop in chai or coffee, or diluted for chest and belly massage.
cardamom-oil.grace_zh: Grace 很喜欢用豆蔻做暖润喉咙的配方。
cardamom-oil.grace_en: Grace likes cardamom for warm throat blends.

rosemary-oil.benefit_zh: 迷迭香让头皮觉得振奋、滋养头发，香气让人清醒，也适合按摩。
rosemary-oil.benefit_en: Rosemary invigorates the scalp, nourishes hair, clears the head and suits massage.
rosemary-oil.use_zh: 几滴加入洗发水，或稀释后按摩头皮；读书时扩香。
rosemary-oil.use_en: Add a few drops to shampoo, or dilute for scalp massage; diffuse while studying.
rosemary-oil.grace_zh: Grace 的头皮和专注配方都少不了它。
rosemary-oil.grace_en: Essential to Grace's scalp and focus blends.

cedarwood-oil.benefit_zh: 雪松营造放松舒服的氛围，也帮助维持健康肌肤和头发。
cedarwood-oil.benefit_en: Cedarwood creates a cosy, relaxing mood and supports healthy skin and hair.
cedarwood-oil.use_zh: 睡前扩香，或稀释后按摩头皮。
cedarwood-oil.use_en: Diffuse at bedtime, or dilute for scalp massage.
cedarwood-oil.grace_zh: 男士和孩子都容易接受雪松的味道。
cedarwood-oil.grace_en: Men and children usually like cedarwood.

marjoram-oil.benefit_zh: 马郁兰香气镇定柔和，按摩时清甜舒缓，让紧绷的身体放松。
marjoram-oil.benefit_en: Marjoram is calm and soft, sweet and soothing in massage for tense bodies.
marjoram-oil.use_zh: 稀释后按摩肩颈、背部，睡前用最好。
marjoram-oil.use_en: Dilute for neck and back massage, best before bed.
marjoram-oil.grace_zh: Grace 的睡眠和脊柱配方常有马郁兰。
marjoram-oil.grace_en: Marjoram often features in Grace's sleep and spine blends.

black-spruce-essential-oil.benefit_zh: 黑云杉镇定放松，让家里空气干净透气，按摩时舒缓，也能清洁舒缓肌肤。
black-spruce-essential-oil.benefit_en: Black spruce calms, freshens the home, soothes in massage and cleanses skin.
black-spruce-essential-oil.use_zh: 扩香，或稀释后按摩背部和腿部。
black-spruce-essential-oil.use_en: Diffuse, or dilute for back and leg massage.
black-spruce-essential-oil.grace_zh: Grace 喜欢在冬天配方里放黑云杉。
black-spruce-essential-oil.grace_en: Grace likes black spruce in winter blends.

black-pepper-oil.benefit_zh: 黑胡椒香气温热，和基底油混合按摩时让皮肤觉得温暖舒缓。
black-pepper-oil.benefit_en: Black pepper is warming; mixed with carrier oil it warms and soothes in massage.
black-pepper-oil.use_zh: 稀释后按摩，或涂在手心嗅吸。
black-pepper-oil.use_en: Dilute for massage, or breathe from your palms.
black-pepper-oil.grace_zh: 想戒烟的客人，Grace 会推荐嗅吸黑胡椒。
black-pepper-oil.grace_en: For clients quitting smoking, Grace suggests breathing black pepper.

spa-replenishing-body-butter.benefit_zh: 滋养身体乳质地丰润，适合干燥的手肘、膝盖和脚跟。
spa-replenishing-body-butter.benefit_en: A rich body butter for dry elbows, knees and heels.
spa-replenishing-body-butter.use_zh: 洗澡后趁皮肤微湿涂抹。
spa-replenishing-body-butter.use_en: Apply after a shower while skin is still damp.
spa-replenishing-body-butter.grace_zh: 也可以加一两滴你喜欢的精油。
spa-replenishing-body-butter.grace_en: You can add a drop or two of your favourite oil.

spa-hand-body-lotion.benefit_zh: 舒活护手润肤乳质地清爽，全身都能用，也适合当作调配精油的无香底。
spa-hand-body-lotion.benefit_en: A light lotion for hands and body, also a good unscented base for adding oils.
spa-hand-body-lotion.use_zh: 直接使用，或加入几滴精油调成自己的乳液。
spa-hand-body-lotion.use_en: Use as is, or add a few drops of oil to make your own.
spa-hand-body-lotion.grace_zh: Grace 调舒缓保湿膏时常用它做底。
spa-hand-body-lotion.grace_en: Grace often uses it as the base for her soothing balms.

patchouli-oil-nhp.scent_zh: 浓郁的泥土和草本，带樟脑感。
patchouli-oil-nhp.scent_en: Rich earth and herbs with camphor.
patchouli-oil-nhp.benefit_zh: 广藿香香气沉稳，让人镇定，也常用于平衡油性肌肤。
patchouli-oil-nhp.benefit_en: Patchouli is deep and grounding, calming, and often used to balance oily skin.
patchouli-oil-nhp.use_zh: 稀释后加入护肤或按摩油，或睡前扩香。
patchouli-oil-nhp.use_en: Dilute into skin or massage oil, or diffuse at bedtime.
patchouli-oil-nhp.grace_zh: 广藿香的味道很有个性，Grace 会先让你闻一闻再决定。
patchouli-oil-nhp.grace_en: It's a distinctive scent; Grace lets you smell it before deciding.

sandalwood-oil-indian-nhp.benefit_zh: 印度檀香温润安定，常用于冥想和睡前放松，也照顾肌肤。
sandalwood-oil-indian-nhp.benefit_en: Indian sandalwood is smooth and settling, used for meditation, bedtime calm and skin care.
sandalwood-oil-indian-nhp.use_zh: 一滴涂在手腕或颈后，静坐时深呼吸；或加入护肤油。
sandalwood-oil-indian-nhp.use_en: A drop on wrists or neck during quiet time; or add to skin oil.
sandalwood-oil-indian-nhp.grace_zh: Grace 很多护肤和安神配方都用檀香做底。
sandalwood-oil-indian-nhp.grace_en: Sandalwood is the base of many of Grace's skin and calming blends.

myrrh-oil-nhp.scent_zh: 微苦烟熏的树脂，带草本。
myrrh-oil-nhp.scent_en: Slightly bitter, smoky resin with herbs.
myrrh-oil-nhp.benefit_zh: 没药是自古就用来照顾肌肤的树脂，让肌肤看起来干净年轻，也加入胸背和喉咙的配方。
myrrh-oil-nhp.benefit_en: An ancient skin-care resin for a clean, youthful look, also used in chest and throat blends.
myrrh-oil-nhp.use_zh: 稀释后涂抹需要照顾的肌肤，或加入护肤油。
myrrh-oil-nhp.use_en: Dilute for skin that needs care, or add to skin oil.
myrrh-oil-nhp.grace_zh: Grace 常把没药和乳香一起用。
myrrh-oil-nhp.grace_en: Grace often pairs myrrh with frankincense.

roman-chamomile-oil-nhp.benefit_zh: 罗马洋甘菊温柔安神，适合睡前和舒缓情绪，敏感的人和孩子也适合。
roman-chamomile-oil-nhp.benefit_en: Roman chamomile is gentle and calming, good at bedtime and for mood, and kind to sensitive people and children.
roman-chamomile-oil-nhp.use_zh: 睡前扩香，或稀释后涂抹脚底和后颈。
roman-chamomile-oil-nhp.use_en: Diffuse at bedtime, or dilute for soles and back of the neck.
roman-chamomile-oil-nhp.grace_zh: Grace 给孩子和敏感肌调配时最常用它。
roman-chamomile-oil-nhp.grace_en: Grace's go-to for children and sensitive skin.

grapefruit-oil-nhp.benefit_zh: 葡萄柚香气清新，让人心情轻松。
grapefruit-oil-nhp.benefit_en: Grapefruit is fresh and lifts the mood.
grapefruit-oil-nhp.use_zh: 扩香，或稀释后按摩。涂抹后避免日晒。
grapefruit-oil-nhp.use_en: Diffuse or dilute for massage. Avoid sun after applying.
grapefruit-oil-nhp.grace_zh: 想要清爽不甜腻的柑橘香，选葡萄柚。
grapefruit-oil-nhp.grace_en: Choose grapefruit for citrus that's fresh, not sweet.

wild-orange-oil-nhp.benefit_zh: 野橘的香气让人开心放松，是最受欢迎的扩香油之一。
wild-orange-oil-nhp.benefit_en: Wild orange makes people happy and relaxed, one of the most popular oils to diffuse.
wild-orange-oil-nhp.use_zh: 扩香 3–4 滴，或加入按摩油。涂抹后避免日晒。
wild-orange-oil-nhp.use_en: Diffuse 3–4 drops or add to a massage oil. Avoid sun after applying.
wild-orange-oil-nhp.grace_zh: 家里有孩子，野橘几乎是必备。
wild-orange-oil-nhp.grace_en: Almost a must in homes with children.

brave.benefit_zh: Brave 是给孩子的复方，香气给人勇气和信心，适合面对新环境。
brave.benefit_en: A children's blend whose scent brings courage and confidence for new situations.
brave.use_zh: 滚涂在孩子的手腕或后颈。
brave.use_en: Roll onto your child's wrists or back of the neck.
brave.grace_zh: 开学、上台前可以给孩子用一点。
brave.grace_en: Nice before the first day of school or a performance.

easy-air.benefit_zh: Easy Air 复方营造通畅透气的环境，让呼吸舒服，也让人放松。
easy-air.benefit_en: Easy Air creates a clear, open atmosphere for easy breathing and relaxation.
easy-air.use_zh: 睡前扩香，或稀释后涂胸口和后背。
easy-air.use_en: Diffuse at bedtime, or dilute for chest and back.
easy-air.grace_zh: 换季时 Grace 工作室每天都扩这一款。
easy-air.grace_en: Grace diffuses it daily in the studio when seasons change.

cheer-essential-oil.benefit_zh: 欢欣复方香气阳光，适合心情低落时给自己打打气。
cheer-essential-oil.benefit_en: A sunny blend for when you need cheering up.
cheer-essential-oil.use_en: Diffuse or roll onto your wrists.
cheer-essential-oil.grace_zh: 灰暗的冬天，Grace 会推荐这一款。
cheer-essential-oil.grace_en: Grace recommends it for grey winter days.

adaptiv-essential-oil-blend.benefit_zh: 乐释复方让人镇定、帮助集中，适合新环境、压力大的时候。
adaptiv-essential-oil-blend.benefit_en: Adaptiv helps you feel calm and focused in new or stressful situations.
adaptiv-essential-oil-blend.use_zh: 扩香，或滴在手心嗅吸后涂抹后颈。
adaptiv-essential-oil-blend.use_en: Diffuse, or breathe from your palms then apply to the back of the neck.
adaptiv-essential-oil-blend.grace_zh: 转工、搬家、考试前都很适合。
adaptiv-essential-oil-blend.grace_en: Good for new jobs, moves and exams.

revitazen.benefit_zh: 元气焕能复方可以为茶和水增添风味，扩香营造活力，也让腹部按摩更舒缓。
revitazen.benefit_en: RevitaZen flavours tea and water, energises a room and makes belly massage more soothing.
revitazen.use_zh: 一滴加入温水，或稀释后按摩腹部。
revitazen.use_en: A drop in warm water, or diluted for belly massage.
revitazen.grace_zh: Grace 会建议搭配规律作息一起使用。
revitazen.grace_en: Grace suggests pairing it with a regular routine.

northern-escape-oil-blend.benefit_zh: 北国秘域复方让家里或办公室空气全天清新，营造镇定正向的氛围。
northern-escape-oil-blend.benefit_en: Northern Escape keeps home or office air fresh all day with a calm, positive mood.
northern-escape-oil-blend.grace_zh: 温哥华的森林味，送朋友很合适。
northern-escape-oil-blend.grace_en: Smells like BC forests; a lovely gift.

adaptiv-touch.benefit_zh: 乐释复方的滚珠版，随身带着，紧张时涂一涂。
adaptiv-touch.benefit_en: Adaptiv in a roller to carry and use when nerves hit.
adaptiv-touch.use_zh: 滚涂在手腕、后颈和耳后。
adaptiv-touch.use_en: Roll onto wrists, back of the neck and behind the ears.
adaptiv-touch.grace_en: Handy before interviews and client meetings.

whisper-touch.benefit_zh: 仕女复方会和你自己的体温、体味结合，变成专属于你的香气。
whisper-touch.benefit_en: Whisper blends with your own skin to become a scent that's yours alone.
whisper-touch.use_zh: 滚涂在手腕、颈侧当香水。
whisper-touch.use_en: Roll onto wrists and neck as a perfume.
whisper-touch.grace_zh: 想要天然香水，这一支很受欢迎。

serenity-essential-oil-blend.benefit_zh: 安宁神气复方营造平静、有利休息的环境，是睡前最受欢迎的复方。
serenity-essential-oil-blend.benefit_en: Serenity creates a calm, restful space and is the most popular bedtime blend.
serenity-essential-oil-blend.use_zh: 睡前 30 分钟扩香，或稀释后涂脚底。
serenity-essential-oil-blend.use_en: Diffuse 30 minutes before bed, or dilute for the soles.
serenity-essential-oil-blend.grace_zh: 睡不好的客人，Grace 常从这一瓶开始。
serenity-essential-oil-blend.grace_en: For poor sleepers, Grace often starts here.

balance-essential-oil-blend.benefit_zh: 安定情绪复方让人觉得踏实顺遂，按摩时香气镇定。
balance-essential-oil-blend.benefit_en: Balance helps you feel grounded and steady, calming in massage.
balance-essential-oil-blend.use_en: Apply to the soles in the morning, or diffuse.
balance-essential-oil-blend.grace_zh: 情绪起伏大的时候，Grace 推荐它打底。
balance-essential-oil-blend.grace_en: Grace recommends it as a base for up-and-down moods.

steady.benefit_zh: 安稳宝贝是给孩子的复方，帮孩子在变化中觉得安心。
steady.benefit_en: A children's blend that helps them feel safe through change.
steady.use_zh: 滚涂在孩子的手腕或脚底。
steady.use_en: Roll onto your child's wrists or soles.
steady.grace_zh: 孩子换环境、睡前不安时适合。
steady.grace_en: Good for children in new places or unsettled at bedtime.

forgive.benefit_zh: 宽容复方让人宁静，帮助放下心里的结。
forgive.benefit_en: Forgive brings calm and helps you let go of what's weighing on you.
forgive.use_zh: 滚涂在心口或手腕，深呼吸。
forgive.use_en: Apply over the heart or on wrists and breathe deeply.
forgive.grace_zh: Grace 会在情绪疏导时搭配使用。
forgive.grace_en: Grace uses it when helping clients work through feelings.

calmer.benefit_zh: 平静宝贝是孩子的睡前复方，让孩子安静下来。
calmer.benefit_en: A children's bedtime blend that helps them settle.
calmer.use_zh: 睡前滚涂在孩子的脚底和后颈。
calmer.use_en: Roll onto your child's soles and back of the neck at bedtime.
calmer.grace_zh: 睡前讲故事时用，孩子会记住这个味道。
calmer.grace_en: Use it at story time and they'll link the scent to sleep.

stronger-oil.benefit_zh: 强韧宝贝是给孩子换季时用的温和复方。
stronger-oil.benefit_en: A gentle children's blend for changing seasons.
stronger-oil.use_zh: 滚涂在孩子的脚底和后背。
stronger-oil.use_en: Roll onto your child's soles and back.
stronger-oil.grace_zh: 上学季节，Grace 会推荐家里备一支。
stronger-oil.grace_en: Grace suggests keeping one at home in school season.

affirm.benefit_zh: 心灵专注复方配合瑜伽或冥想，帮助你接纳自己、觉得平静。
affirm.benefit_en: Affirm supports yoga or meditation, helping you feel accepting and calm.
affirm.use_zh: 练习前涂在手心深呼吸。
affirm.use_en: Breathe from your palms before practice.
affirm.grace_zh: 有练瑜伽的客人很喜欢。
affirm.grace_en: Clients who do yoga love it.

arise.benefit_zh: 心灵启蒙复方让人觉得快乐、清晰、有勇气。
arise.benefit_en: Arise brings joy, clarity and courage.
arise.use_zh: 早上或练习前涂在手腕。
arise.use_en: Apply to wrists in the morning or before practice.
arise.grace_zh: 想要开始新目标时可以用。

anchor.benefit_zh: 心灵恒定复方让人觉得完整、冷静、有根。
anchor.benefit_en: Anchor helps you feel whole, calm and rooted.
anchor.use_zh: 静坐前涂在脚底或尾椎。
anchor.use_en: Apply to soles or the base of the spine before sitting quietly.
anchor.grace_zh: 心很乱的时候，Grace 推荐先用它。
anchor.grace_en: When your mind is scattered, Grace starts with this.

console.benefit_zh: 抚慰复方给人慰藉和希望，适合失去和难过的时候。
console.benefit_en: Console offers comfort and hope in times of loss and sadness.
console.use_zh: 涂在心口，或扩香陪伴自己。
console.use_en: Apply over the heart, or diffuse to keep you company.
console.grace_zh: 难过的时候，不用一个人扛。
console.grace_en: You don't have to carry sadness alone.

endless-summer-oil.benefit_zh: 无尽夏日复方让空间像夏天一样明亮轻快。
endless-summer-oil.benefit_en: Endless Summer makes a room feel bright and light as summer.
endless-summer-oil.grace_en: A good friend in Vancouver's rainy season.

citrus-bliss-essential-oil-blend.benefit_zh: 柑橘清新复方香气明亮有活力，也能清新衣物和家居。
citrus-bliss-essential-oil-blend.benefit_en: Citrus Bliss is bright and energising, and freshens laundry and home.
citrus-bliss-essential-oil-blend.use_zh: 扩香，或滴在洗衣球上烘干衣物。
citrus-bliss-essential-oil-blend.use_en: Diffuse, or add to a dryer ball for laundry.
citrus-bliss-essential-oil-blend.grace_zh: 想让家里有阳光味，就用它。
citrus-bliss-essential-oil-blend.grace_en: For a home that smells like sunshine.

citrus-bloom-blend.benefit_zh: 柑橘绽放复方带来春天的气息，也可以当作个人香氛。
citrus-bloom-blend.benefit_en: Citrus Bloom brings a breath of spring and works as a personal scent.
citrus-bloom-blend.grace_zh: 春天 Grace 工作室常用的香气。
citrus-bloom-blend.grace_en: A spring favourite in Grace's studio.

shinrin-yoku-blend.benefit_zh: 森之音复方让你在家也能感受森林浴的宁静。
shinrin-yoku-blend.benefit_en: Shinrin-Yoku brings the calm of forest bathing indoors.
shinrin-yoku-blend.use_en: Diffuse and breathe deeply for a few minutes.
shinrin-yoku-blend.grace_zh: 没空去山里时，用它也很放松。
shinrin-yoku-blend.grace_en: When you can't get to the woods, this helps.

passion-oil.benefit_zh: 热情复方让人振奋、找回热情，营造欢乐的氛围。
passion-oil.benefit_en: Passion lifts you up and rekindles enthusiasm, creating a joyful mood.
passion-oil.grace_zh: 日子太平淡时，可以试试。
passion-oil.grace_en: Try it when life feels flat.

immortelle-oil.benefit_zh: 花漾年华复方帮助改善肌肤外观，让肌肤光滑、有光泽、看起来年轻。
immortelle-oil.benefit_en: Immortelle improves the look of skin for a smooth, glowing, youthful appearance.
immortelle-oil.use_zh: 洁面后滚涂在脸和颈部，轻轻按开。
immortelle-oil.use_en: After cleansing, roll onto face and neck and press in.
immortelle-oil.grace_zh: Grace 推荐熟龄肌肤每天用。
immortelle-oil.grace_en: Grace recommends it daily for mature skin.

peace.scent_zh: 香甜的花香带一点薄荷。
peace.scent_en: Sweet florals with a hint of mint.
peace.benefit_zh: 静谧复方让人觉得平和，按摩时香气舒适，适合焦躁不安的时候。
peace.benefit_en: Peace brings a sense of calm and comfort, made for restless moments.
peace.use_zh: 涂在手腕和心口，深呼吸几次。
peace.use_en: Apply to wrists and over the heart, and take a few deep breaths.
peace.grace_zh: Grace 会在情绪配方里用它打底。
peace.grace_en: Grace builds mood blends on it.

frankincense-essential-oil.benefit_zh: 乳香被称为精油之王，香气放松又振奋，涂抹时滋养干燥肌肤、维持肌肤健康，也和几乎所有精油都搭。
frankincense-essential-oil.benefit_en: Called the king of oils: relaxing yet uplifting, nourishing for dry skin and compatible with almost every other oil.
frankincense-essential-oil.use_zh: 静坐或睡前扩香；护肤时一两滴加入乳液；稀释后按摩也很温和。
frankincense-essential-oil.use_en: Diffuse during quiet time or before bed; add a drop or two to lotion; gentle in massage when diluted.
frankincense-essential-oil.grace_zh: Grace 说，不知道选什么的时候，先选乳香。
frankincense-essential-oil.grace_en: Grace says: when in doubt, start with frankincense.

ylang-ylang-oil.benefit_zh: 伊兰伊兰香气振奋又镇定，滋养秀发和头皮，也清新空间。
ylang-ylang-oil.benefit_en: Ylang ylang uplifts and calms, nourishes hair and scalp, and freshens a room.
ylang-ylang-oil.use_zh: 睡前扩香 1–2 滴，或加入护发油。香气浓，少量就好。
ylang-ylang-oil.use_en: Diffuse 1–2 drops at bedtime or add to hair oil. It's strong, so a little goes far.
ylang-ylang-oil.grace_zh: Grace 常在睡眠和暖心配方里点一点。
ylang-ylang-oil.grace_en: Grace adds a touch to sleep and heart blends.

bergamot-essential-oil.scent_en: Sweet citrus with a little spice.
bergamot-essential-oil.benefit_zh: 佛手柑香气明亮，让心情轻快，也能清洁肌肤、带来活力。
bergamot-essential-oil.benefit_en: Bergamot is bright and lifts the mood, and cleanses and refreshes the skin.
bergamot-essential-oil.use_zh: 扩香，或涂在手心嗅吸。涂抹后 12 小时内避免日晒。
bergamot-essential-oil.use_en: Diffuse or breathe from your palms. Avoid sun on the skin for 12 hours after applying.
bergamot-essential-oil.grace_zh: 情绪类配方里，Grace 最常用的柑橘就是佛手柑。
bergamot-essential-oil.grace_en: Bergamot is the citrus Grace uses most in mood blends.

arborvitae-essential-oil.benefit_zh: 侧柏香气温暖朴实，营造焕然一新的氛围，也能清洁表面和肌肤。
arborvitae-essential-oil.benefit_en: Arborvitae is warm and earthy, refreshes a space and cleanses surfaces and skin.
arborvitae-essential-oil.use_zh: 扩香，或稀释后加入按摩油。
arborvitae-essential-oil.use_en: Diffuse, or dilute into a massage oil.
arborvitae-essential-oil.grace_zh: Grace 会在背部配方里用它增加木香。
arborvitae-essential-oil.grace_en: Grace uses it to add wood to back blends.

touch-magnolia.benefit_zh: 木兰花滚珠舒缓干燥肌肤、促进健康肤质，香气镇静。
touch-magnolia.benefit_en: Magnolia Touch soothes dry skin, supports healthy skin and calms with its scent.
touch-magnolia.use_zh: 滚涂在手腕、颈部或需要滋润的地方。
touch-magnolia.use_en: Roll onto wrists, neck or dry areas.
touch-magnolia.grace_zh: 喜欢清雅花香的人会很爱它。
touch-magnolia.grace_en: Loved by anyone who likes delicate florals.

neroli-touch.benefit_zh: 橙花滚珠香气镇静振奋，舒缓干燥肌肤、让肤况看起来年轻。
neroli-touch.benefit_en: Neroli Touch calms and uplifts, soothes dry skin and supports a youthful look.
neroli-touch.use_zh: 滚涂在手腕、脸颊，敏感肌也适用。
neroli-touch.use_en: Roll onto wrists or cheeks; gentle on sensitive skin.
neroli-touch.grace_en: A lovely gift for a new mum.

touch-helichrysum-oil.benefit_zh: 永久花滚珠帮助肌肤恢复活力、看起来年轻，也改善肌肤外观的瑕疵。
touch-helichrysum-oil.benefit_en: Helichrysum Touch revitalises skin, supports a youthful look and improves the appearance of blemishes.
touch-helichrysum-oil.use_zh: 洁面后滚涂在需要的地方。
touch-helichrysum-oil.grace_zh: 想每天用永久花护肤，这一支最方便。
touch-helichrysum-oil.grace_en: The easiest way to use helichrysum daily.

touch-myrrh.benefit_zh: 没药滚珠滋润安抚肌肤，香气放松镇静。
touch-myrrh.benefit_en: Myrrh Touch moisturises and soothes skin with a relaxing scent.
touch-myrrh.use_zh: 滚涂在需要滋润的肌肤或手腕。
touch-myrrh.use_en: Roll onto dry skin or wrists.
touch-myrrh.grace_zh: 手干、脚跟干的时候很好用。
touch-myrrh.grace_en: Great for dry hands and heels.

rose-touch.benefit_zh: 玫瑰滚珠平衡肌肤水分、让肤色明亮，香气让人提升、丰盈。
rose-touch.benefit_en: Rose Touch balances skin moisture, brightens tone and lifts with its rich scent.
rose-touch.use_zh: 滚涂在手腕、颈侧或脸颊。
rose-touch.use_en: Roll onto wrists, neck or cheeks.
rose-touch.grace_zh: 玫瑰精油很珍贵，滚珠是入门的好选择。
rose-touch.grace_en: Rose oil is precious; the roller is a great way in.

jasmine-touch.benefit_zh: 茉莉滚珠平衡肌肤水分、滋润干燥，香气让人欢愉放松。
jasmine-touch.benefit_en: Jasmine Touch balances and moisturises skin, and its scent is joyful and relaxing.
jasmine-touch.use_zh: 滚涂在手腕、颈侧当香水。
jasmine-touch.use_en: Roll onto wrists and neck as a perfume.
jasmine-touch.grace_en: A touch before a date or party.

lavender-touch.benefit_zh: 薰衣草滚珠舒缓滋润肌肤，香气放松平静。
lavender-touch.benefit_en: Lavender Touch soothes and moisturises skin with a calm, relaxing scent.
lavender-touch.use_zh: 睡前滚涂在脚底、后颈或手腕。
lavender-touch.use_en: Roll onto soles, back of the neck or wrists at bedtime.

tulsi-holy-basil-oil.benefit_zh: 圣罗勒香气镇静，也帮助保持口腔卫生、让气色看起来健康。
tulsi-holy-basil-oil.benefit_en: Tulsi calms, supports oral hygiene and a healthy-looking complexion.
tulsi-holy-basil-oil.use_zh: 扩香，或稀释后加入护肤油。
tulsi-holy-basil-oil.use_en: Diffuse, or dilute into skin oil.
tulsi-holy-basil-oil.grace_zh: 想要温暖又安静的香气，可以试试。
tulsi-holy-basil-oil.grace_en: Try it for a scent that's warm yet quiet.

hawaiian-sandalwood-oil.benefit_zh: 夏威夷檀香放松镇定，让秀发和皮肤看起来健康有光泽。
hawaiian-sandalwood-oil.benefit_en: Hawaiian sandalwood relaxes and calms, and gives hair and skin a healthy glow.
hawaiian-sandalwood-oil.use_zh: 一滴加入护肤油或护发油，或冥想时涂手腕。
hawaiian-sandalwood-oil.use_en: A drop in skin or hair oil, or on wrists for meditation.
hawaiian-sandalwood-oil.grace_zh: Grace 的护肤配方很喜欢它。
hawaiian-sandalwood-oil.grace_en: A favourite in Grace's skin blends.

geranium-oil.scent_zh: 绿叶花香，带玫瑰般的甜。
geranium-oil.scent_en: Green-leaf florals with a rosy sweetness.
geranium-oil.benefit_zh: 天竺葵帮助清洁皮肤和头皮、改善肌肤外观，香气让人平衡。
geranium-oil.benefit_en: Geranium cleanses skin and scalp, improves the look of skin and brings balance.
geranium-oil.use_zh: 稀释后加入护肤油或洗发水；也可以扩香。
geranium-oil.use_en: Dilute into skin oil or shampoo; or diffuse.
geranium-oil.grace_zh: 女性的情绪和护肤配方，Grace 常用天竺葵平衡。
geranium-oil.grace_en: Grace uses geranium to balance women's mood and skin blends.

vetiver-oil.scent_zh: 香甜焦糖般的根部香，带烟熏。
vetiver-oil.benefit_zh: 岩兰草香气朴实安定，是睡眠和专注配方的重要成员。
vetiver-oil.benefit_en: Vetiver is earthy and settling, key to sleep and focus blends.
vetiver-oil.use_zh: 睡前涂在脚底，或者学习时扩香 1–2 滴。很黏稠，倒的时候耐心一点。
vetiver-oil.use_en: Apply to soles at bedtime or diffuse 1–2 drops while studying. It's thick, so pour patiently.
vetiver-oil.grace_zh: Grace 说岩兰草是把心拉回来的油。
vetiver-oil.grace_en: Grace calls vetiver the oil that brings your mind home.

guaiacwood-oil.benefit_zh: 愈创木香气镇静，舒缓滋润肌肤，营造适合冥想的静谧。
guaiacwood-oil.benefit_en: Guaiacwood calms, soothes and moisturises skin, and creates a meditative stillness.
guaiacwood-oil.use_zh: 扩香，或稀释后加入护肤油。
guaiacwood-oil.use_en: Diffuse, or dilute into skin oil.
guaiacwood-oil.grace_en: Often used in Grace's men's blends.

lemon-eucalyptus-oil.benefit_zh: 柠檬尤加利香气清新通畅，户外活动时让人愉悦，也能清洁肌肤和表面。
lemon-eucalyptus-oil.benefit_en: Lemon eucalyptus is fresh and open, lovely outdoors, and cleanses skin and surfaces.
lemon-eucalyptus-oil.use_zh: 户外扩香，或稀释后涂抹。
lemon-eucalyptus-oil.use_en: Diffuse outdoors, or dilute and apply.
lemon-eucalyptus-oil.grace_zh: 夏天露营、野餐的好伙伴。
lemon-eucalyptus-oil.grace_en: A summer camping and picnic favourite.

rose-oil.benefit_zh: 玫瑰精油平衡肌肤水分、让肤色明亮，香气让人感到被爱与丰盈。
rose-oil.benefit_en: Rose balances skin moisture, brightens tone and makes you feel loved and full.
rose-oil.use_zh: 一滴加入面霜，或涂在手腕和心口。
rose-oil.use_en: A drop in face cream, or on wrists and over the heart.
rose-oil.grace_zh: 一瓶玫瑰要几千朵花，每一滴都很珍贵。
rose-oil.grace_en: Thousands of petals go into every bottle; each drop counts.

tangerine-oil.benefit_zh: 甜橘香气清新提振，让人苏醒，也能改善肌肤外观。
tangerine-oil.benefit_en: Tangerine is fresh and awakening, and improves the look of skin.
tangerine-oil.use_zh: 早上扩香，或加入饮用水。涂抹后避免日晒。
tangerine-oil.use_en: Diffuse in the morning or add to water. Avoid sun after applying.
tangerine-oil.grace_zh: 孩子通常很喜欢这个味道。

sweet-fennel-oil.benefit_zh: 甜茴香香气甜美温暖，腹部按摩时特别舒服，也能清新口气。
sweet-fennel-oil.benefit_en: Sweet fennel is sweet and warm, wonderful in belly massage and for fresh breath.
sweet-fennel-oil.use_zh: 稀释后顺时针按摩腹部。孕期请先咨询。
sweet-fennel-oil.use_en: Dilute and massage the belly clockwise. Ask before using in pregnancy.
sweet-fennel-oil.grace_zh: Grace 的经期和肠胃配方常有甜茴香。
sweet-fennel-oil.grace_en: Sweet fennel is common in Grace's period and digestive blends.

spikenard-oil.benefit_zh: 穗甘松配合夜间保湿，软化角质、舒缓皮肤，按摩腹部时香气振奋。
spikenard-oil.benefit_en: Spikenard softens and soothes skin with night cream, and uplifts in belly massage.
spikenard-oil.use_zh: 一滴加入晚霜，或稀释后按摩腹部。
spikenard-oil.use_en: A drop in night cream, or diluted for belly massage.
spikenard-oil.grace_zh: 古老而独特的香气，不是人人喜欢，先闻再选。
spikenard-oil.grace_en: An ancient, unusual scent; smell before you choose.

grapefruit-oil.benefit_zh: 葡萄柚帮助清洁皮肤和头皮，香气振奋纯净，也能加入饮品。
grapefruit-oil.benefit_en: Grapefruit cleanses skin and scalp, has a pure uplifting scent and suits drinks.
grapefruit-oil.use_zh: 扩香，或稀释后按摩。涂抹后避免日晒。
grapefruit-oil.use_en: Diffuse, or dilute for massage. Avoid sun after applying.
grapefruit-oil.grace_zh: Grace 的眼周轻盈配方用的就是它。
grapefruit-oil.grace_en: Grace uses it in her light eye-area blends.

blue-lotus-touch.benefit_zh: 蓝睡莲滚珠香气珍稀，让人放松、心情柔软。
blue-lotus-touch.benefit_en: A rare Blue Lotus scent that relaxes and softens the mood.
blue-lotus-touch.use_zh: 滚涂在手腕、心口，冥想前用。
blue-lotus-touch.use_en: Roll onto wrists and over the heart before meditation.
blue-lotus-touch.grace_zh: 很特别的香气，适合给自己一份礼物。
blue-lotus-touch.grace_en: A special scent, a gift to yourself.

lavender-oil.scent_zh: 甜美的薰衣草花香和草本。
lavender-oil.benefit_zh: 薰衣草散发平静镇定的香气，舒缓滋润干燥肌肤，也帮助保持头发健康。
lavender-oil.benefit_en: Lavender is calming, soothes and moisturises dry skin and supports healthy hair.
lavender-oil.use_zh: 睡前扩香、滴在枕头上；稀释后涂抹肌肤或按摩。
lavender-oil.use_en: Diffuse or put on your pillow at bedtime; dilute for skin or massage.
lavender-oil.grace_zh: Grace 的睡眠配方几乎都从薰衣草开始。
lavender-oil.grace_en: Almost all of Grace's sleep blends start with lavender.

yarrow-pom.benefit_zh: 西洋蓍草和石榴籽油的组合，滋润肌肤、让肌肤看起来年轻透亮。
yarrow-pom.benefit_en: Yarrow with pomegranate seed oil: it nourishes skin for a young, clear look.
yarrow-pom.use_zh: 洁面后取一两滴按摩在脸上。
yarrow-pom.use_en: After cleansing, press one or two drops into your face.
yarrow-pom.grace_zh: Grace 的抗老护肤配方常用它。
yarrow-pom.grace_en: Grace uses it in anti-ageing skin blends.

wild-orange-oil.benefit_zh: 野橘香气清甜振奋，也能清新口气、改善家里的气味。
wild-orange-oil.benefit_en: Wild orange is sweet and uplifting, freshens breath and makes the home smell good.
wild-orange-oil.use_zh: 扩香，或一滴加入饮用水。涂抹后避免日晒。
wild-orange-oil.use_en: Diffuse, or one drop in water. Avoid sun after applying.
wild-orange-oil.grace_zh: 最容易让人笑起来的香气。
wild-orange-oil.grace_en: The scent most likely to make you smile.

green-mandarin-oil.scent_en: Citrus and fruit, sweet with florals.
green-mandarin-oil.benefit_zh: 青橘香气有活力，帮助清洁皮肤、改善肌肤外观。
green-mandarin-oil.benefit_en: Green mandarin is lively, cleanses skin and improves its appearance.
green-mandarin-oil.use_zh: 扩香，或加入饮用水。涂抹后避免日晒。
green-mandarin-oil.use_en: Diffuse or add to water. Avoid sun after applying.
green-mandarin-oil.grace_zh: 比一般橘子更清新，Grace 很喜欢。
green-mandarin-oil.grace_en: Fresher than regular mandarin; a Grace favourite.

melissa-oil.benefit_zh: 香蜂草香气柔和，按摩时让人放松，也让肌肤焕然一新。
melissa-oil.benefit_en: Melissa is gentle, relaxing in massage and refreshing for skin.
melissa-oil.use_zh: 一滴涂在心口或手腕，或加入按摩油。
melissa-oil.use_en: A drop over the heart or on wrists, or added to massage oil.
melissa-oil.grace_zh: 香蜂草非常珍贵，Grace 的暖心配方会用到。
melissa-oil.grace_en: Very precious; Grace uses it in heart blends.

madagascar-vanilla-essential-oil.benefit_zh: 马达加斯加香草营造轻松舒适的氛围，香气浓郁复合。
madagascar-vanilla-essential-oil.benefit_en: Madagascar vanilla creates a cosy, comfortable mood with a rich, layered scent.
madagascar-vanilla-essential-oil.use_zh: 扩香，或加入乳液当香氛。
madagascar-vanilla-essential-oil.use_en: Diffuse, or add to lotion as a scent.
madagascar-vanilla-essential-oil.grace_zh: 冬天的晚上，用它配上柑橘最舒服。
madagascar-vanilla-essential-oil.grace_en: Lovely with citrus on winter evenings.

douglas-fir-oil.benefit_zh: 黄杉香气清新舒畅，创造积极的环境，按摩时让人有活力。
douglas-fir-oil.benefit_en: Douglas fir is fresh and open, creates a positive space and energises in massage.
douglas-fir-oil.grace_zh: Grace 的专注配方常用它。

spa-moisturizing-bath-bar.benefit_zh: 保湿沐浴皂洗后不紧绷，适合干性肌肤每天使用。
spa-moisturizing-bath-bar.benefit_en: A moisturising bar that leaves skin comfortable, good for dry skin daily.
spa-moisturizing-bath-bar.use_en: Lather on wet skin to cleanse.
spa-moisturizing-bath-bar.grace_zh: 洗完再涂一点精油按摩油，保湿更好。
spa-moisturizing-bath-bar.grace_en: Follow with a little massage oil for extra moisture.

spa-balance-bath-bar.benefit_zh: 安定平衡沐浴皂让洗澡时间也能放松。
spa-balance-bath-bar.benefit_en: A Balance bar that turns your shower into a calm moment.
spa-balance-bath-bar.use_en: Lather on wet skin to cleanse.
spa-balance-bath-bar.grace_zh: 早上洗澡用，让一天踏实开始。
spa-balance-bath-bar.grace_en: Use in the morning to start the day grounded.

spa-citrus-bliss-hand-lotion.benefit_zh: 柑橘清新护手乳让双手滋润，也让心情明亮。
spa-citrus-bliss-hand-lotion.benefit_en: Citrus Bliss hand lotion moisturises and lifts the mood.

citrus-bliss-bath-bar.benefit_zh: 柑橘清新沐浴皂含柑橘果皮粉温和去角质，香气振奋。
citrus-bliss-bath-bar.benefit_en: A Citrus Bliss bar with citrus peel powder for gentle exfoliation and an uplifting scent.
citrus-bliss-bath-bar.use_zh: 打湿后起泡，在粗糙的地方轻轻打圈。
citrus-bliss-bath-bar.use_en: Lather and work in gentle circles on rough areas.
citrus-bliss-bath-bar.grace_en: Most refreshing in a morning shower.

spa-rose-hand-lotion.benefit_zh: 玫瑰护手乳滋润双手，留下淡淡玫瑰香。
spa-rose-hand-lotion.benefit_en: Rose hand lotion moisturises and leaves a soft rose scent.

serenity-bath-bar.scent_zh: 安宁神气的柔和薰衣草。
serenity-bath-bar.benefit_zh: 神气复方沐浴皂含荷荷巴籽油，晚上洗澡时让人放松。
serenity-bath-bar.benefit_en: A Serenity bar with jojoba oil to relax you in an evening shower.
serenity-bath-bar.grace_zh: 洗完澡再扩一点安宁神气，入睡更顺。
serenity-bath-bar.grace_en: Diffuse Serenity after for an easier bedtime.

spa-hydrating-body-mist.benefit_zh: 精油保湿喷雾随时补水，让皮肤和心情都清爽。
spa-hydrating-body-mist.benefit_en: A hydrating body mist for skin and mood any time.
spa-hydrating-body-mist.use_zh: 离身体 20 厘米喷在身上。
spa-hydrating-body-mist.grace_zh: 飞机上、冷气房里很好用。
spa-hydrating-body-mist.grace_en: Great on planes and in air-conditioned rooms.

spa-refreshing-body-wash.benefit_zh: 精油沐浴露清洁又保湿，洗完清爽。
spa-refreshing-body-wash.benefit_en: A body wash that cleanses and moisturises for a fresh finish.
spa-refreshing-body-wash.use_zh: 取适量在湿润皮肤上起泡后冲净。
spa-refreshing-body-wash.use_en: Lather on wet skin and rinse.
spa-refreshing-body-wash.grace_zh: 也可以加几滴你喜欢的精油。
spa-refreshing-body-wash.grace_en: Add a few drops of your favourite oil.

spa-exfoliating-body-scrub.benefit_zh: 精油身体磨砂膏去除老化角质，让皮肤光滑。
spa-exfoliating-body-scrub.benefit_en: A body scrub that removes dull skin for a smooth finish.
spa-exfoliating-body-scrub.use_zh: 每周一两次，在湿润皮肤上打圈按摩后冲净。
spa-exfoliating-body-scrub.use_en: Once or twice a week, massage in circles on wet skin and rinse.
spa-exfoliating-body-scrub.grace_zh: 磨砂后涂按摩油，吸收更好。
spa-exfoliating-body-scrub.grace_en: Massage oil absorbs better after a scrub.

lemon-oil-nhp.benefit_zh: 柠檬香气舒爽，登记为天然健康产品，芳香疗法中用于舒缓感冒和咳嗽。
lemon-oil-nhp.benefit_en: A refreshing lemon registered as an NHP, used in aromatherapy to ease colds and coughs.
lemon-oil-nhp.use_zh: 扩香，或涂在手心嗅吸。涂抹后避免日晒。
lemon-oil-nhp.use_en: Diffuse or breathe from your palms. Avoid sun after applying.
lemon-oil-nhp.grace_zh: 换季时 Grace 会和尤加利一起扩香。
lemon-oil-nhp.grace_en: Grace diffuses it with eucalyptus when seasons change.

tea-tree-oil-nhp.benefit_zh: 茶树滋润干燥皲裂的肌肤，清洁感强，也是天然的除臭剂。
tea-tree-oil-nhp.benefit_en: Tea tree soothes dry, cracked skin, feels strongly cleansing and works as a natural deodoriser.
tea-tree-oil-nhp.use_zh: 稀释后点涂在需要的地方，或加入清洁喷雾。
tea-tree-oil-nhp.use_en: Dilute and dab where needed, or add to a cleaning spray.
tea-tree-oil-nhp.grace_en: A household staple with many uses.

intune-oil-blend.benefit_zh: InTune 复方营造专注的环境，适合工作和学习。
intune-oil-blend.benefit_en: InTune creates a focused space for work and study.
intune-oil-blend.use_zh: 滚涂在太阳穴、后颈和手腕。
intune-oil-blend.use_en: Roll onto temples, back of the neck and wrists.
intune-oil-blend.grace_zh: 孩子写功课坐不住时可以试试。
intune-oil-blend.grace_en: Try it when children can't sit still for homework.

motivate-essential-oil-blend.benefit_zh: 鼓舞复方让空间明朗愉悦，帮你找回做事的动力。
motivate-essential-oil-blend.benefit_en: Motivate brightens a room and helps you find your drive.
motivate-essential-oil-blend.grace_zh: 拖延的时候，先闻一闻再开始。

zengest.benefit_zh: 乐活复方香气舒缓，腹部按摩时让人舒服，也能为水增添甘甜风味。
zengest.benefit_en: ZenGest is soothing, comforting in belly massage and adds a sweet flavour to water.
zengest.use_zh: 稀释后顺时针按摩腹部，或一滴加入温水。
zengest.use_en: Dilute and massage the belly clockwise, or one drop in warm water.
zengest.grace_zh: Grace 的肠胃配方几乎都从乐活开始。
zengest.grace_en: Nearly all of Grace's digestive blends start with ZenGest.

on-guard-blend.benefit_zh: 保卫复方清洁皮肤和表面，扩香时温暖舒适，也能为茶和水调味。
on-guard-blend.benefit_en: On Guard cleanses skin and surfaces, warms a room and flavours tea and water.
on-guard-blend.use_zh: 扩香，或稀释后涂脚底；也可以做清洁喷雾。
on-guard-blend.use_en: Diffuse, or dilute for the soles; or make a cleaning spray.
on-guard-blend.grace_zh: 换季和上学季节，Grace 家里天天扩。
on-guard-blend.grace_en: Grace diffuses it daily at home in school season.

purify-oil-blend.benefit_zh: 净化清新复方消除恼人的异味，让空间清新洁净。
purify-oil-blend.benefit_en: Purify clears unwanted odours and leaves a space fresh and clean.
purify-oil-blend.use_en: Diffuse, or add to a cleaning spray.
purify-oil-blend.grace_en: Good for kitchens, bathrooms and cars.

touch-zengest.scent_zh: 辛香清甜，带薄荷和甘草。
touch-zengest.scent_en: Sweet spice with mint and liquorice.
touch-zengest.benefit_zh: 乐活复方滚珠，按摩腹部时舒缓，敏感皮肤也适用。
touch-zengest.benefit_en: ZenGest in a roller; soothing in belly massage and gentle on sensitive skin.
touch-zengest.use_zh: 滚涂在腹部，顺时针轻揉。
touch-zengest.use_en: Roll onto the belly and rub clockwise.
touch-zengest.grace_zh: 旅行包里一定要放一支。
touch-zengest.grace_en: A must for your travel bag.

on-guard-touch.benefit_zh: 保卫复方滚珠，香气有活力，也促进皮肤清洁。
on-guard-touch.benefit_en: On Guard in a roller: a lively scent that supports clean skin.
on-guard-touch.grace_en: Easy to use before heading out.

terrashield-spray.benefit_zh: 天然防护喷雾散发振奋的香氛，户外活动时随身带。
terrashield-spray.benefit_en: TerraShield spray has an uplifting scent to take outdoors.
terrashield-spray.use_zh: 出门前喷在衣物和外露皮肤上，避开脸部。
terrashield-spray.use_en: Spray on clothes and exposed skin before going out, avoiding the face.
terrashield-spray.grace_zh: 夏天露营、行山时很实用。
terrashield-spray.grace_en: Useful for summer camping and hikes.

terrashield-essential-oil.benefit_zh: 天然防护复方让户外活动时保持芬芳，适合全家使用。
terrashield-essential-oil.benefit_en: TerraShield keeps you smelling fresh outdoors and suits the whole family.
terrashield-essential-oil.use_zh: 稀释后涂抹外露皮肤，或滴在衣物上。
terrashield-essential-oil.use_en: Dilute on exposed skin, or put on clothing.
terrashield-essential-oil.grace_zh: Grace 会教你自己调成喷雾。
terrashield-essential-oil.grace_en: Grace can show you how to make your own spray.

ddr-prime.benefit_zh: 完美修护复方为肌肤带来温暖舒缓的感觉。
ddr-prime.benefit_en: DDR Prime gives skin a warm, soothing feel.
ddr-prime.use_zh: 稀释后涂抹或加入按摩油。
ddr-prime.use_en: Dilute and apply, or add to a massage oil.
ddr-prime.grace_zh: Grace 在暖心配方里会搭配使用。
ddr-prime.grace_en: Grace pairs it in heart blends.

abode.benefit_zh: 居家复方让家里气味保持洁净，带来清新的柑橘香，去除陈腐气味。
abode.benefit_en: Abode keeps the home smelling clean with fresh citrus and clears stale odours.
abode.use_en: Diffuse, or add to cleaning products.
abode.grace_zh: 搬新家、大扫除后用最好。
abode.grace_en: Perfect after moving in or a deep clean.

thinker-oil.benefit_zh: 智慧宝贝复方营造令人振奋的学习氛围，敏感肌也适用。
thinker-oil.benefit_en: Thinker creates an uplifting study mood and is gentle on sensitive skin.
thinker-oil.use_zh: 写功课前滚涂在孩子的手腕和后颈。
thinker-oil.use_en: Roll onto your child's wrists and neck before homework.
thinker-oil.grace_zh: 考试季家长常来问这一支。
thinker-oil.grace_en: Parents ask for this one in exam season.

hd-clean.benefit_zh: 清肌调理复方适合需要清爽护理的肌肤。
hd-clean.benefit_en: HD Clean suits skin that needs fresh, clean care.

air-x-essential-oil.benefit_zh: 赋活呼吸复方焕新家和办公室，也有局部清洁的功效。
air-x-essential-oil.benefit_en: Air-X refreshes home and office and offers local cleansing.
air-x-essential-oil.grace_en: Great when the air feels stale.

tea-tree-touch.scent_en: Herbs, grass and a leathery note.
tea-tree-touch.benefit_zh: 茶树滚珠滋润干燥龟裂的皮肤，香气清爽，敏感肌适用。
tea-tree-touch.benefit_en: Tea Tree Touch soothes dry, cracked skin with a clean scent; fine for sensitive skin.
tea-tree-touch.grace_zh: 放在家里的医药箱旁边。
tea-tree-touch.grace_en: Keep it with the first-aid kit.

lemon-oil.benefit_zh: 柠檬香气振奋正向，能清洁居家台面、去除黏腻，也能为饮用水增添柑橘风味。
lemon-oil.benefit_en: Lemon is uplifting and positive, cleans counters and sticky marks, and flavours water.
lemon-oil.use_zh: 一滴加入饮用水，或扩香；涂抹后避免日晒。
lemon-oil.use_en: One drop in water, or diffuse; avoid sun after applying.
lemon-oil.grace_zh: Grace 每天早上的第一杯水就有柠檬。
lemon-oil.grace_en: Grace's first glass of water each morning has lemon in it.

oregano-oil.benefit_zh: 牛至香气强烈，清洁功效强，按摩时提供强化的香氛。
oregano-oil.benefit_en: Oregano is intense and strongly cleansing, adding power to a massage scent.
oregano-oil.use_zh: 一定要大量稀释，配方里通常只放一两滴。
oregano-oil.use_en: Always dilute heavily; usually just one or two drops in a blend.
oregano-oil.grace_zh: 牛至是最强的油之一，请让 Grace 帮你调。
oregano-oil.grace_en: One of the strongest oils; let Grace blend it for you.

cilantro-oil.benefit_zh: 胡荽叶营造清新提振的氛围，外用让肌肤舒缓放松。
cilantro-oil.benefit_en: Cilantro freshens and lifts a space and soothes skin when applied.
cilantro-oil.grace_zh: Grace 在头部舒压配方里会用一点。
cilantro-oil.grace_en: Grace adds a little to head-tension blends.

lime-oil.benefit_zh: 莱姆赋予肤色健康光彩，也能清洁头发和头皮，为水增添清新风味。
lime-oil.benefit_en: Lime gives skin a healthy glow, cleanses hair and scalp and freshens water.
lime-oil.use_zh: 一滴加入饮用水，或扩香；涂抹后避免日晒。
lime-oil.use_en: A drop in water or diffuse; avoid sun after applying.

citronella-oil.scent_zh: 清新草本带柠檬和玫瑰。
citronella-oil.scent_en: Fresh herbs with lemon and rose.
citronella-oil.benefit_zh: 香茅让室内外都有愉悦的香气，按摩时镇定，也能清洁表面。
citronella-oil.benefit_en: Citronella makes indoors and out smell pleasant, calms in massage and cleans surfaces.
citronella-oil.use_zh: 户外扩香，或稀释后涂抹。
citronella-oil.use_en: Diffuse outdoors, or dilute and apply.
citronella-oil.grace_zh: 夏天后院烧烤时扩一点。
citronella-oil.grace_en: Diffuse it at a summer backyard barbecue.
